RESTful API endpoints for interacting with DataHub metadata using the OpenAPI standard. Provides endpoints for managing entities, querying relationships, retrieving timeline history, and emitting platform events. The OpenAPI endpoints offer the most powerful and flexible lower-level access to the DataHub metadata graph, supporting reads and writes of entity-aspect pairs, relationship traversal, versioned history queries, and batch operations. Recommended for advanced users who need programmatic control over the metadata graph beyond what the GraphQL API provides.
